home.heroTitle: Learn every subject, from grade 1 to 12
home.heroText: Complete courses in Math, Algebra, Geometry, Physics, Drawing and Languages, built on the Armenian and Russian school curricula and available in English, Armenian and Russian.
home.curriculumText: Every course explains how the topic is taught in Armenia and in Russia, so pupils, parents and teachers in either system can follow along.

grade.noCourses: No courses for this grade yet.

tips.subtitle: Shortcuts, memory aids and habits that are not in the standard course.

footer.madeFor: Built for pupils, parents and teachers in Armenia and Russia.

exam.title: Exams
exam.intro: Practice for the real thing: the Armenian state final and unified exams, the Russian ОГЭ and ЕГЭ, and a year-end trial test for every course. All questions are original, written in the style of the real papers, and come with explanations.

systemText.armenia: Final assessments by the Assessment and Testing Centre (ԳԹԿ): grade 4 knowledge check, grade 9 final exams, grade 12 state finals and the unified university entrance exams. Results on the 20-point scale.
systemText.russia: State final attestation set by ФИПИ: the ОГЭ after grade 9 and the ЕГЭ after grade 11. Results converted to the familiar 5-point mark.

exam.trialsText: One practice test per subject and grade. Take it in May to see whether the year's material is really yours.
exam.courseSectionText: Check the whole year in exam mode: a year-end trial and, where it exists, the state exam for this subject.
exam.readyText: {n} questions, {points} points, about {min} minutes. You will see the answers only after you finish, as in a real exam.
exam.unansweredConfirm: {n} questions are still unanswered. Finish anyway?
exam.scaleNote: The marks are an approximate conversion. Real exams publish a conversion table every year, and schools may set their own thresholds.
exam.question: Question {n} of {total}

auth.loginText: Log in to keep track of your lessons and quiz scores.
auth.signupText: Pick a username and a password. No email needed.
auth.usernameHint: 3–24 Latin letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores

errors.bad_username: Use 3–24 Latin letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
errors.disabled: This account is disabled. Ask your teacher or parent.
errors.not_configured: Accounts are not set up on this server yet.
errors.password_short: The password is too short: use at least 4 characters.

progress.title: My progress
progress.emptyText: Open a lesson and finish its quiz, or mark it done. Your results will show up here.

review.title: Daily Review
review.intro: A few minutes a day keeps what you learned. Questions come back just before you would forget them.
review.ready: {n, plural, one {# question ready} other {# questions ready}}
review.caughtUpText: Every question is reviewed. New ones arrive tomorrow; meanwhile you can learn a new lesson.
review.daysThisWeek: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of the last 7
review.mistakesCount: {n, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} in the mistake notebook
review.practiseIntro: Questions you got wrong last time. Answer one correctly and it leaves the notebook.
review.emptyText: Take a lesson quiz or an exam: its questions come back here at the right moment.
review.noMistakesText: Every mistake is fixed. Questions you answer wrongly will show up here.
review.summaryGood: Great work! These questions will come back later.
review.summaryOk: Good. The ones you missed come back tomorrow.
review.summaryLow: That is what review is for. The ones you missed come back tomorrow, and you can reread the lesson.
review.notebookIntro: Questions you got wrong last time, with the right answer and why. They come back in the Daily Review until you get them right.

warmup.title: Warm-up
warmup.intro: {n, plural, one {One question} other {# questions}} from earlier lessons. Answer from memory before reading on: recalling old material helps it stick.
warmup.done: Warmed up. On to the new lesson!

recall.title: Close the book
recall.intro: Before the quiz, hide the lesson and write down what you remember. Putting it in your own words is one of the best ways to learn.
recall.label: What do you remember?
recall.placeholder: Main ideas, rules, words, an example…
recall.noObjectives: Scroll up and check what you missed.
recall.after: Anything you missed is worth a quick reread.

mastery.intro: {n} questions mixed from every lesson of this unit, with the answers at the end. Get {pct}% or more to master it.
mastery.noQuestions: This unit has no quiz questions yet.
mastery.passed: Unit mastered. Keep it that way with your Daily Review.
mastery.failed: Not mastered yet: you need {pct}%. Go over the lessons below, then take the check again.
mastery.weakPrereqTitle: Start with what this unit builds on
mastery.weakPrereqText: These earlier units are not solid yet, and this one depends on them:
mastery.notSaved: Could not send your answers. Check the internet connection.

practice.title: Practise unit {n}
practice.intro: Questions picked for your level, one at a time, with the answer straight after. They get harder as you get them right and easier when you get stuck.
practice.readiness: Ready for about {pct}% of this unit's questions
practice.readinessChanged: Ready for {from}% → {to}% of this unit's questions
practice.notSaved: Could not check your answer. Check the internet connection.

questions.orderHint: Use the arrows to put them in order.

plan.title: Plan to the exam
plan.cardTitle: Plan your way to this exam
plan.cardBody: A short test finds what you already know, then you get a plan for every day until the exam.
plan.cardYours: Your plan: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
plan.noSkills: There is nothing to plan for this exam yet.
plan.setupIntro: First, a short test of up to {n} questions finds what you already know. Then you get a plan for each day: what to practise, when to check yourself and when to try the full exam.
plan.startError: Could not start. Check the date and the internet connection.
plan.testIntro: Answer what you can. The test does not show right answers: it only finds where to start. If you don't know, press “I don't know”, that helps too.
plan.notSaved: Could not save your answer. Check the internet connection.
plan.daysLeft: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to the exam
plan.tooMuch: Not everything fits before the exam: {n, plural, one {# unit does} other {# units do}} not get full practice. More minutes a day would help.
plan.todayAllDone: All done for today. Well done!
plan.lastDay: The day before the exam: just a light review today, then rest.

taskHint.trial: The full exam, against the clock

plan.groupsIntro: From {n, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}} in the test and your work since.
plan.updateHint: “Update the plan” rebuilds it from today with what you know now.
plan.removeConfirm: Remove this plan? Your answers stay in your history.
plan.actionError: Could not save. Check the internet connection.

motivation.title: This week
motivation.streak: {n, plural, one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}
motivation.freezeLeft: Freeze ready: one missed day this week keeps your streak.
motivation.freezeUsed: This week's freeze kept your streak on {day}.
motivation.best: Best: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
motivation.goalError: Could not save. Check the internet connection.
motivation.how: A day counts when you answer {n} questions. Points come from right answers (each question once a day), twice as many in Daily Review, and 20 for each unit check you pass the first time. Time spent gives no points.
motivation.badgesIntro: Master units to earn subject badges: bronze for 1, silver for 5, gold for 15. Keep a streak for the streak badges.
motivation.masteredN: {n, plural, one {# unit mastered} other {# units mastered}}
motivation.nextTier: {n, plural, one {# more unit} other {# more units}} for the next badge
motivation.noBadges: Pass a unit check to master your first unit and earn a badge.
